sv.title: It-chef på Riksbanken arbetsbefriad
sv.summary: Riksbankens it-chef Mats Eklund har arbetsbefriats tills vidare, dock som längst till årsskiftet, skriver myndigheten i ett pressmeddelande.

en.title: Riksbank IT chief relieved of duties
en.summary: Riksbank IT chief Mats Eklund has been relieved of his duties until further notice, though for no longer than until the end of the year, the agency writes in a press release.
